Messages.Author: Guillaume Comeau
Messages.Body:
I d like to know if I played that game properly:

Dollface is equipped with a Talbots chain and a .44 magnum. 
Is this legal?

She attacks a minion and uses the magnum, preventing damage with the 
chainsaw.
Is this legal?

Can she press using the Talbots chainsaw? Is she forced to press since it is 
not an optional press? If so, Is she supposed to press even if her opponent
to continue combat?

Thanks for all

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Guillaume Comeau <gcomeau@etu.gel.ulaval.ca> wrote:
>Dollface is equipped with a Talbots chain and a .44 magnum.
>Is this legal?

Sure.

>She attacks a minion and uses the magnum, preventing damage with the
>chainsaw.
>Is this legal?
>Can she press using the Talbots chainsaw? Is she forced to press since it is
>not an optional press? If so, Is she supposed to press even if her opponent
>to continue combat?

While it's true that if you use a weapon's maneuver then you must use
it as a strike, I'm not sure whether that's meant to extend to using
the weapon for pressing or damage prevention.  Probably it does not,
since neither function happens until after strikes are declared; this
means that I think you can use the Magnum to strike (and perhaps maneuver),
and then use the Chainsaw to prevent damage and to press.  I'll check on that.
